options.text_cn: 车沿底线将死被兵封住的王
options.text_en: A rook checkmates a king trapped behind its pawns on the back rank

options.text_cn: 后在对角线将死王，王的两个斜向逃格被己方棋子封住
options.text_en: A queen gives check along a diagonal while the king's two diagonal escape squares are blocked by its own pieces

options.text_cn: 马将军，王被己方棋子堵死所有逃格
options.text_en: A knight checks while the king's own pieces block every escape square
Two queens work together to checkmate the enemy king

explanation_cn: 燕尾杀的特征是后在对角线给王将军，而王斜向的两个逃格被己方棋子封住，形状像燕子的尾巴。王通常夹在己方两个棋子之间，无路可逃。
explanation_en: In a dovetail mate, the queen gives check along a diagonal while the king's two diagonal escape squares are occupied by its own pieces, resembling a swallow's tail. The king is trapped between its own pieces with nowhere to move.
